title: Search approved repository document names
outcome: Return the first limit matching Markdown filenames from the approved top-level repository index, sorted by filename; query matching is case-insensitive substring matching. Set truncated according to the observed matching count.
non_guarantees: Does not cover unapproved collections or assert that source-provided content is universally correct.

preconditions.description: Inputs select an approved read-only collection.
Read authority for the approved source is required.

postconditions.criterion: Return the first limit matching Markdown filenames from the approved top-level repository index, sorted by filename; query matching is case-insensitive substring matching. Set truncated according to the observed matching count.
evidence_required: Receiver-generated successful source-operation receipts and digest-verified source artifacts.

failures.meaning: A required approved source is unavailable, denied, or outside the allocation.
